svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The stack that runs in production, and the three places it diverges
svg.desc: The browser reaches an Azure Container Apps ingress fronting the FastAPI harness. The harness builds one SandboxAgent per run, opens one E2B container for the method files, and reaches all business data through a second, internal-only container app running the MCP server, which is the only component that touches Neon Postgres. Below, the two components of the reference stack that are absent here, each with its reason.
svg.text: The deployed stack, and the three divergences
Same control-plane / execution-plane split as the reference. Three differences, each a decision.
Browser · Blazor WebAssembly
buttons and chat — ONE conversation
HTTPS · Easy Auth
AZURE CONTAINER APPS · SCALE-TO-ZERO
FastAPI harness — the control plane
1 vCPU · 2 GiB · min 0 / max 1 replica
Holds every root credential. They never leave here.
Owns the run lifecycle, the approval gate on
public.runs, and the audit's own connection.
DIVERGENCE 1 · NOT IN THE REFERENCE STACK
content-data — the MCP data plane
0.5 vCPU · 1 GiB · INTERNAL ingress — not on the internet
10 model-visible tools, 25 internal. No run_sql, no DDL.
MCP over HTTP
Application Insights · 100% sampled · one run_id everywhere
E2B container
ONE PER RUN · up in ~1s, gone in 0.25s
ZERO credentials. No network.
.agents/propune-postari/
.agents/dezvolta-postarea/ + references/
shell — the model opens the method itself
Neon Postgres + pgvector
pooled for the app, direct for migrations
16 tables · 4,778 embedded chunks
A write and its audit row commit in ONE transaction.
the only component that touches it
Arize Phoenix — the sample. Neon is the record.
IN THE REFERENCE STACK, ABSENT HERE — EACH ONE A DECISION, NOT AN OMISSION
DIVERGENCE 2
Cloudflare Sandbox + bridge Worker
The reference routes Python clients through a Worker that exposes the Sandbox
API over HTTP. E2B needs no bridge and no paid plan: one fewer network
boundary, and one fewer thing to authenticate.
DIVERGENCE 3
Cloudflare R2
Refused outright, not postponed. Her posts are domain rows in Postgres, not
downloadable files. /health reports artifacts inactive WITH the reason, so the
refusal is visible in the running system rather than only in a plan.
